output.title: Clinical Note
output.what_it_says: This document is a clinical note for patient SUNIL TEST PATIENT. It records that the patient complains of an intermittent headache for two weeks and does not have a fever. The note is signed by Dr. P. Kulkarni.

terms.plain_explanation: A written record of a patient's health concerns and symptoms documented by a doctor.
A headache that comes and goes, rather than being constant or continuous.
